restaurant_name: คลีนิกทันตกรรม B@S (BTSแบริ่ง)
text:
They all speak English very well, and the massage is also good.
Maybe because I'm a foreigner, they kept trying to get me to do a trial massage. The second time I went, I told them I wanted to try someone else since I'd already tried it the last time. :) I think it's a good idea to try different massages.
The price is now 250 baht!

text: 200 baht per hour. The facility is old, but you can enjoy Thai massage at a reasonable price. I registered a year ago and was approved, so I'm happy.
